mapper.insert: insert into review (order_id, goods_id, user_id, target_user_id, score, content, images, anonymous, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{orderId}, #{goodsId}, #{userId}, #{targetUserId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{images}, #{anonymous}, now(), now(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select * from review where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1

select r.id, r.order_id as orderId, r.goods_id as goodsId, r.user_id as userId, r.target_user_id as targetUserId, r.score, r.content, r.images, r.anonymous, r.create_time as createTime, u.name as reviewerName, u.avatar as reviewerAvatar from review r left join `user` u on r.user_id = u.id where r.order_id = #{orderId} limit 1

select r.id, r.order_id as orderId, r.goods_id as goodsId, r.user_id as userId, r.target_user_id as targetUserId, r.score, r.content, r.images, r.anonymous, r.create_time as createTime, u.name as reviewerName, u.avatar as reviewerAvatar from review r left join `user` u on r.user_id = u.id where r.goods_id = #{goodsId} order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc
